summary: Iter14: per-customer prefs (custom price per plan, fixed plan, discount block, reminder selection) + admin 'Pagamento confirmado' alert text. Backend: 16/17 pytest pass (in-process create_payment with mocked InfinitePay). Frontend: Customers 'Preço' dialog and /pay pages verified. Found and fixed (minimal) a CRITICAL runtime crash on dialog close plus stale data when the dialog is reopened. All test prefs and temp payments are cleaned up.

minor.issue: Dot-decimal input is parsed wrongly: '25.50' becomes 255000 cents (R$ 2.550,00) because set_prefs strips every '.' as a thousands separator. An admin typing 25.50 silently charges 100x. Fix: if the string has '.' but no ',', treat the '.' as the decimal point, or reject ambiguous input. Also add an upper sanity cap.

The recovery-coupon sweep (auto_recovery_coupon) ignores customer_prefs. A customer with no_discount=true still gets a WhatsApp with a coupon that validate_coupon will then reject. It also ignores notify_events. It should skip when discount_blocked(user_id).
Does not apply wants_event, so 'Avisos' still shows reminders the customer opted out of as scheduled/today.
fixed_plan is only enforced for the main customer_id. An extra login whose own fixed_plan is 3 can still be renewed with plan_months=1 through multi-points.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL (FIXED by tester): after Salvar, closing (X/Esc) or switching customer, the app crashed with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading default_prices)'. Cause: onClose sets customer=null, so the query is disabled and data is undefined, while the f state stayed non-null and the closing dialog still rendered data.default_prices. Fix: render only when f && data, and reset f when data is undefined.

HIGH (FIXED by tester): reopening the dialog in the same session showed the old pre-save values, because queryClient staleTime is 60s and nothing invalidated the query. Saving again would silently revert the changes. Fix: qc.invalidateQueries(['customer-prefs', id]) in onSuccess.

integration_issues.issue: discountedPrice applies effectivePct to every selected login, but the backend skips the discount for extra logins with no_discount=true. If a discount is active and a blocked extra is selected, the displayed total is lower than what is charged (not exercised live, found by code review).

action_items: Fix set_prefs price parsing for '25.50' (dot decimal) and add a sanity cap
Skip auto_recovery_coupon sends for discount-blocked customers (and respect notify_events if intended)
Enforce each extra login's fixed_plan in create_payment (or exclude such logins from linked_accounts for other plans)
PublicPay: do not apply the discount % to linked logins with no_discount (expose discounts_blocked per linked account)
Review the tester's CustomerPrefsDialog fixes (guard on data + invalidateQueries)
critical_code_review_comments: routers/customer_prefs.py takes a raw request.json() with no Pydantic model. Validation is manual (int(fixed) on garbage raises ValueError, which becomes 400; OK, but a model would be cleaner).
set_prefs treats int values as cents but string values as reais, which is inconsistent.
Admin alert (payments.py ~1174-1195): operator precedence verified correct. Payment method, account, logins count (only when >1), clover yes/no + count, and discount/coupon lines are present.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after tester fixes (crash and stale data reproduced before the fix)

seed_data_creation: Temporary customer_prefs docs for 227470351/227470352 and 2 temp payments from the mocked create_payment were all deleted (Mongo prefs remaining=0; SQLite and Mongo have no pending payments for the test ids). The backend in-process prefs cache expires within 60s.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PRODUCTION env. Run: pytest tests/test_customer_prefs_iter14.py -n 0 (test_zz_cleanup deletes prefs and created payments). Use only 227470206/351/352. Afterwards run python tests/cleanup_iter14.py. Test test_dot_decimal_price is expected to fail until the parsing fix lands.
rca of the issue: Dialog crash: CustomerPrefsDialog kept local form state f after customer became null on close. React Query with enabled=false returned data=undefined while the Radix Dialog close animation was still rendering children, so data.default_prices threw. Repro: open Preço, click Salvar (or X), and the runtime error overlay appears.
